item.text:
# Cedar Repair Cafe distribution assessment

**As of 25 April 2027, readiness for distributing the public invitation is not established.** The event details and scheduled volunteer coverage pass. Written permission for the illustration remains a material **UNKNOWN**.

The requirements below come from [event/assignment.md](event/assignment.md). This is an advisory assessment, not legal certification or release approval.

| Requirement | Status | Supporting and contrary evidence | Concrete next action and limitations |
|---|---|---|---|
| Invitation matches the confirmed date, place and hours | **PASS** | [Invitation](event/invitation.md) and [venue confirmation](venue/reservation.eml) both specify **15 May 2027, 10:00–13:00, Cedar Community Hall, 18 Cedar Road**. The contrary [earlier proposal](event/old-note.txt) names Oak Pavilion on 8 May, but explicitly says it was superseded; the confirmation also supersedes prior proposals. | Retain these confirmed details in the distributed invitation. This establishes agreement between the inspected records, not independent verification of the booking. |
| Named illustration is present and has written public-use permission for the invitation | **UNKNOWN** | The [invitation](event/invitation.md) identifies **Blue Wrench, ART-17**, at `media/blue-wrench.svg`. The [actual SVG](media/blue-wrench.svg) is present and contains the matching title “Blue Wrench ART-17.” Presence therefore passes. Written permission was not established from the inspected evidence; no retrieved evidence establishes a prohibition either. | Obtain an authorized written permission record explicitly covering ART-17’s public use in this invitation. `rights/` was excluded as instructed; permission cannot be inferred from the asset’s presence or from the lack of accessible permission evidence. |
| Volunteer schedule covers the full confirmed public hours | **PASS** | The [confirmed roster](ops/volunteers.txt) assigns Alex **09:30–11:30** and Sam **11:30–13:00**, providing continuous coverage of **10:00–13:00**, including cleanup. The [current schedule](ops/schedule.csv) opens at 10:00 and closes at 13:00; cleanup at 12:30 is explicitly “while open.” The [earlier noon-closing draft](ops/earlier-schedule.txt) explicitly says it was replaced. | Preserve coverage through 13:00. Actual attendance is expressly unknown, but the documented requirement concerns scheduled coverage, which is supported. |

No requirement is classified **FAIL** or **NOT APPLICABLE**.

Only relevant event, venue, illustration and staffing records were read. `rights/` was not inspected, and no external services or real platform actions were used. No separately supplied earlier review was available for a readiness comparison; superseded proposals and schedules were reconciled as source evidence. No additional requirement was inferred from unrelated archive materials. No report was saved and no files were changed.

**One safe next step:** obtain an authorized written permission record covering public use of Blue Wrench ART-17 in this invitation, then reassess that requirement before treating the materials as ready.
